"""Convert legacy Meridian CRM ACCT_MASTER rows to modern account records."""

from typing import Any


def _number(value: str) -> float:
    """Convert a legacy numeric string, treating an empty value as zero."""
    return float(value) if value != "" else 0.0


def _date(value: str) -> str | None:
    """Convert YYYYMMDD to ISO format, honoring legacy null sentinels."""
    if value == "" or value == "00000000":
        return None
    return f"{value[0:4]}-{value[4:6]}-{value[6:8]}"


def convert_account(row: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Convert one ACCT_MASTER CSV row, excluding soft-deleted records."""
    if row.get("DEL_FLG", "") == "Y":
        return None

    get: Any = row.get
    currency = get("CURR_CD", "")

    return {
        "account_id": get("ACCT_ID", ""),
        "name": get("ACCT_NM", ""),
        "account_type": get("ACCT_TYP", ""),
        "sic_code": get("SIC_CD", ""),
        "region": get("REGION_CD", ""),
        "annual_revenue": _number(get("ANN_REV", "")),
        "currency": currency if currency != "" else "USD",
        "owner_id": get("OWNER_UID", ""),
        "team_code": get("TEAM_CD", ""),
        "credit_limit": _number(get("CRED_LIMIT", "")),
        "credit_hold": get("CRED_HOLD", "") == "Y",
        "created_date": _date(get("CREATE_DT", "")),
        "updated_date": _date(get("UPD_DT", "")),
    }
